Kimi, here we go
Another triumph, the World Championship will arrive on Sunday with a ninth-place finish
Antonelli also dominates at the GP in Austin: His ninth victory. The title to arrive in Mexico. Leclerc second

Corriere dello Sport
Lucio calls Juve
Beats Lecce and starts to claw back: ‘We need to give more’
14 points and seventh place | Beats DiFra 2-0 without nine players: ‘We win for those who have this club in their hearts’
McKennie and Douglas Luiz get it done in 41 minutes: ‘A serious first-half performance, but we went backwards in the second’. The test at Marassi on Wednesday
Inter never give up
Another crazy comeback: Fiorentina beaten 2-1
Jimenez masterpiece, then Chivu fights back in the 91st and 97th minute with goals from Thuram and Zielinski. Mariani, what an error!
Milan catch Gasp
Amorim passes through with a 2-0 in Udine and draws level with Roma
Pulisic and Hutchinson secure the consolation after the midweek European flop. Runjaic trembling: Six consecutive defeats
Tuttosport
Juve and Luiz get it done
Douglas returns as a protagonist and seals the victory along with McKennie, resurrecting Spalletti and the supporters
Lecce never worry them, the Bianconeri focus on the basics and avoid any nonsense: Woltemade and Kolo don’t make an impact, but they’re now back in level-sixth with Frosinone, who claimed a sensational 4-4 draw against Atalanta. Lucio: ‘We don’t concede goals on the counter attack in a 3-5-2, I hope to get some sleep now, but I’ll be wide awake again if I think about the second half’
It ends with Inter on penalties
Thuram transcends: Viola gotten the better of
Toro, time to banish the Como nightmare?
Last year, the Granata conceded 11 goals in two games against Fabregas. Now after three consecutive wins …
